expectations.text: references_track_by_name: The roll_progress call references the journey track by name
expectations.evidence: track_name="Journey to Deepcrag" present in the (wrongly named) tool call

expectations.text: strong_hit_bonus_offered: On a strong hit, the two bonus options are offered: make another move now (+1) OR take +1 momentum
